references.text: Zerah is mentioned as the son of Judah and Tamar, twin brother to Perez. This is the same Zerah who founded the Zerahite clan.
Saul is mentioned as the son of Simeon and a Canaanite woman. He is the ancestor of the Shaúlite clan mentioned here.
Saul is mentioned again as the son of Simeon in the genealogy, the same one who founded the Shaúlite clan.
Zerah from the tribe of Judah is also mentioned, and the Zerahite clan is counted among Judah's descendants.
Saul is listed in the genealogy of Simeon in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place among the sons of Simeon.
